name: Translate text and summarize or explain content
description: Users asked for text to be translated into various languages, often combined with requests for content summarization, technical explanations, or specific analyses. The tasks frequently involved translating academic abstracts, technical specifications, or code-related text while requiring the assistant to provide context or refined translations for specific domains.
